import json,re
p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/APPLE_2022_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(p) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
texts=data['texts']
patterns=[re.compile(r'net income',re.I), re.compile(r'net loss',re.I), re.compile(r'income \\(loss\\)',re.I)]
for i,t in enumerate(texts):
    txt=t.get('text','')
    if any(p.search(txt) for p in patterns):
        print('IDX',i,'PAGE',t.get('page_no'),'LABEL',t.get('label'),'TEXT',txt[:300].replace('\\n',' '))
PY"
